title: Resolve physical native-history spans and exclude 1,012 Z-ABI images (no new κ)
body:
## Result and mathematical scope

Resolve the actual-phase native-history question left open by [#5427](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5427), and exclude a concrete larger Z-ABI image bank. This is a source-bound separation theorem with **no new κ**.

The physical operator algebra matters: the 215 actual signed operators have a genuine four-term linear relation at width one. The theorem includes that relation rather than treating distinct formal words as independent matrices.

1. At **every positive tensor width**, scalar combinations of all retained full-frame versions contain no nonzero pure-original-Y observation, for the frozen #5402 backward word and both final #4610 orientations. All 632 original inputs remain independent. Exact version/projection ranks are 546/546, 554/554 and 554/554.
2. On the backward provider, grant each version one independently chosen left image from `{I, Kp_i, Km_a, Km_a^-1 Kp_i}`. The **1,012** distinct physical maps and **59** history operators produce **59,708** pairwise nonproportional products. This fixed image span contains no nonzero pure-Y observation for every **f ≥ 59,707**, excluding an exact all-width observer within this family.

The full history is granted even past the intended exit. The enlarged family is a finite bank of once-applied maps; it is not closure under arbitrary further products, arbitrary free monomial controls, partial-frame observations, changed words or additional paid/correlated history. No enlarged-family small-width exclusion is claimed. Current Y must be the native return `Y=Dy`; a later caller Y mixed with X is a different target.

## What is new and how it is proved

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d81d47e6d107e3c52b4583526d31e102b219bdc/research/physical-zqy-scalar-span/PROOF.md), [RESULT.json](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d81d47e6d107e3c52b4583526d31e102b219bdc/research/physical-zqy-scalar-span/RESULT.json) and [ABI-CLOSURE.json](https://github.com/thu-nmrc/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6d81d47e6d107e3c52b4583526d31e102b219bdc/research/physical-zqy-scalar-span/ABI-CLOSURE.json) define the review object.

- Actual signed monomial composition includes inverse-transpose/backward conjugation and absolute phase. The 72 source labels contain 58 different native operators.
- Exact Fraction ranks give upper bounds. At width one, the exact four-term operator relation and a separate nonzero minor prove physical rank 214. Physical non-Y projection lower bounds meet the rational upper bounds. **Modular nonmembership is not used as a rational exclusion.** A separate optional exact quotient checker independently reproduces the ranks without modular inference.
- A 215-by-215 Gaussian-integer tensor-square Gram matrix has determinant 298401053 modulo 1000000009. Every operator fixes the zero state with coefficient one; contraction proves independence for all larger widths, even with width-dependent complex coefficients.
- The ABI checker proves literal phase-correct F9 commutation and distinct product supports. A classical separating-functional argument supplies its explicit eventual-width guard. The source-specific observations and certificates are new; finite projective tensor separation is not claimed as a new general lemma.

## Sources, ownership and comparison

Publication base is canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. It selects conditional κ=.003027288235 from #5413/#5414. This PR leaves the selected result and all frozen packages unchanged, and changes no paid or productive histogram.

Scientific runtime inputs are five existing canonical files, with exact Git blobs and hashes in SOURCES.json. The source histories are the #5402 provider and final #4610 word. The new paid observations in #5413's neutral completion are a separate changed-history resource and are **not** excluded by this result. Constructive work must specify that changed resource and pay its complete bill.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-zqy-scalar-span
```

All **six registered normal/optimized checks pass**, including the exact native spans, one-column physical relation/rank, tensor-square Gram, independent Clifford phase audit and fixed ABI census. The phase audit covers 147,456 native columns and 36,864 product columns. Positive observation injection and wrong-phase controls pass. Internal AI corroboration is separated from independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Committed-byte preflight passes for **23 package/input files** at `6d81d47e6d107e3c52b4583526d31e102b219bdc`; official export and archive integrity checks pass. All six exported commands also pass in a read-only, Git-free directory with files mode 0444, directories mode 0555 and no Git on PATH; pre/post file hashes are identical (archive SHA256 `42c8d5f5b3daf0934163ce7b98fa06841200ed1e802d1a0558fd660f31b2e2e6`). The checkout is shallow; optional full-history preflight was not run. Direct base/publication ancestry passes. The [hosted registered-package workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40117707466) also passes at that exact head. This is replay evidence, not scientific acceptance.

No selected cold replay, new complete native admission, compiler/outer, precision/tape/stock, Lean, Docker or full multiplication-theorem audit is claimed. The scientific review targets are the rank sandwich, width-two contraction, and the physical/fixed-family ABI interpretation. Archival publication remains distinct from that review.

Mark/Matarener (#5427) supplies the question and adapted event/version semantics; Dillon Amburgey (#5402) the coupled provider; Cao Yifan (#4610) the final native word; zxv (#5415/#5419) the observer/consumer ABI. Preserve Cinna Davis, Dugongue, Ali Romman, Jacob Alan Sussman, Chris R/Clear1nsight and all retained native, phase, tensor, controller and compiler notices, linked in README.md.

The next constructive target is a changed native prefix or genuinely new paid caller observation retaining pure Ry before Dx mixing, with current-version ownership, all original inputs and the complete observer/termination bill. Repeating this frozen scalar/finite-ABI family is stopped.
